task_label: Harden semantic multi-step routine reuse with fail-closed and ambiguity guards
problem_statement: The approved second Spec 31 slice must harden the already-delivered semantic multi-step routine reuse path so missing parameters, conflicting values, and ambiguous candidate matches fail closed instead of reusing stale saved-routine values. This slice may harden the existing calendar.list_events + system.routing pilot and the preserved calendar.list_events + system.weather path only. It must not reopen the accepted positive pilot behavior, widen to new routine families, or introduce broader product redesign.

latest_user_evidence.actual: TASK-SPEC31.1 is sealed, but the current semantic reuse hardening still lacks conservative guards for missing parameters, conflicting values, and multiple superficially matching routines.
latest_user_evidence.expected: Semantic routine reuse stays on the normal request path when required parameters are missing, contradictory, or ambiguous, while the accepted routing pilot and weather regression path remain protected.

acceptance_criteria: Only allowlisted backend routine/orchestrator files and focused tests may change.
When required parameters are missing or cannot be extracted safely, Janus does not reuse an old saved routine with stale values.
When a new request contains conflicting or changed values, those values are not silently overwritten by historical routine-run values.
When multiple saved routines only partially or superficially match, Janus stays on the normal request path instead of aggressively false-matching.
Regression coverage protects both the calendar+routing pilot and the existing calendar+weather reuse family.
Do not add UI, routine management, embeddings, vector search, provider fallback, transport changes, OAuth, Git, release, or broader architecture changes.
cursor_prompt_contract: Use Cursor for one bounded execution patch. Inspect only allowlisted files, harden the semantic routine reuse path for missing/conflicting/ambiguous parameters, keep the accepted positive pilot behavior stable, protect the weather regression path, run the listed checks, and return concise JSON-compatible output.
